verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas exposes a documented Editor API (api.playcanvas.com/editor) for programmatic scene/asset manipulation and automation, a REST API for project management, and an official MCP server enabling AI assistants to drive the Editor directly, all backed by first-party docs and a runtime probe confirming the published npm package. missing for 10: no formal OpenAPI/swagger spec found (404s on probe), and no independent/hands-on developer report specifically validating the Editor API or REST API in practice.
